releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.193: Smart Reminder and Personal Calendar ring unanswered repeats exactly at the selected Snooze interval and stop after the configured repeat limit. Manual Snooze shares the same limit; Done cancels repeats. Existing daily repeat, ringtone, saved data and unrelated features are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary Web Update 315: In Edit mode, Personal Calendar and Smart Reminder show all saved entries immediately below the top controls. The add form and search/tools are hidden while selecting; checkboxes are ready at the top. Done restores the normal screen. Saved data and alarm/reminder behavior are preserved.
